snippet.title: Pegs X Stickers - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Here's your look at the Pegs X Stickers announcement trailer for this upcoming pachinko-roguelite that combines Balatro with the cult-classic Peggle, from developer Mister Morris Games, creator of Rusty’s Retirement and Haiku the Robot. Pegs X Stickers will be available on PC via Steam in August 2026.

In Pegs X Stickers, build varied pegboards while combining them with unique stickers to create different synergies and builds. Score points to progress, discover hidden combinations, and find new ways to break the game.
